title: French-Style Charred American Steak
description: A classic French-inspired dish with a charred American steak served with a side of garlic butter and roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: American Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cut like ribeye or strip loin.

ingredients.name: Garlic Butter
ingredients.notes: Melted butter with minced garlic and parsley.

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite vegetables like asparagus, bell peppers, or zucchini.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the steak and vegetables.

ingredients.name: Meat Thermometer
ingredients.notes: For ensuring the steak is cooked to a safe temperature.

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Brush the steak with olive oil and place on the grill.
Cook the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Use a meat thermometer to ensure the steak is cooked to a safe internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
While the steak is cooking, brush the vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the vegetables on the grill and cook for 3-5 minutes per side, or until they are tender.
Remove the steak and vegetables from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the steak with a pat of garlic butter and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve immediately.
